html:
The Miskito are an Indigenous people of the Caribbean coast of Nicaragua and Honduras, the region called the Mosquito Coast. Their language is one of the small Misumalpan family, related to that of the Mayangna inland.

From the 1600s the Miskito traded with English pirates and settlers, got muskets, and grew strong at the expense of their neighbours. Africans from shipwrecks and escapes married into them. The English recognised a line of Miskito kings, crowned in Jamaica or Belize, and the "Mosquito Kingdom" was a British protectorate on and off until the late 1800s. Nicaragua took the coast in 1894.

In the 1980s many Miskito resisted the Sandinista government, which forced thousands from their river villages. Peace brought an autonomous region on the coast in 1987.
